purpose: Legal fold and seam terms for modifying hex terrain surfaces after base tactical height is assigned.

fold_types.mountain: Raises a ridge along a crease line.
fold_types.valley: Lowers a trench along a crease line.
fold_types.hinge: Soft transition seam used for ramps or bends.
fold_types.cut: Hard terrain discontinuity or exposed break.
fold_types.seam: Explicit stitch line between terrain, structure, or chunk systems.
